2024-09-20.label: Announced bank financing
2024-09-20.claim: BNP Paribas announces a financing commitment for asset-backed credit originated by Apollo and ATLAS SP.
2024-09-20.limit: The release describes a commitment. It does not establish actual drawdowns or their current status.
2024-09-20.watch: Drawdowns, maturities and changes to the agreement.

2024-09-20.label: Announced majority ownership
2024-09-20.claim: The release describes ATLAS SP as majority-owned by Apollo funds.
2024-09-20.limit: The investing funds are separate from the Apollo asset manager balance sheet. The release does not detail their individual stakes.

2026-07-29.label: Investment management mandate
2026-07-29.claim: Ares Capital Management manages ARCC under an investment advisory and management agreement.
2026-07-29.limit: The manager and the financing company are separate entities.

2026-07-29.label: Bank facility agent
2026-07-29.claim: JPMorgan is the administrative agent for the ARCC credit facility cited in exhibit 10.1.
2026-07-29.limit: Acting as agent does not mean JPMorgan provides all the lending.

2026-07-29.label: Lender and administrative agent
2026-07-29.claim: BNP Paribas is a lender and the administrative agent for the ARCC FB Funding facility.
2026-07-29.limit: The facility finances this vehicle; it does not identify a particular ultimate borrower.

2026-07-29.label: Equity ownership and loan servicing
2026-07-29.claim: ARCC is the equity owner and loan servicer of ARCC FB Funding in exhibit 10.3.
2026-07-29.limit: The vehicle borrows separately from its parent.

2026-07-29.label: Senior secured loan
2026-07-29.claim: ARCC reports a first-lien senior secured loan to Hyland Software as of June 30, 2026.
2026-07-29.limit: One reported holding does not describe all of Hyland's debt.
2026-07-29.watch: Repayments and the next investment schedule.

2026-08-10.label: Management of the insurer's portfolio
2026-08-10.claim: Athene states that Apollo manages substantially all of its investments as of June 30, 2026.
2026-08-10.limit: This mandate does not turn the insurer's obligations into debts of Apollo-managed funds.

2026-08-10.label: Ownership of investment vehicles
2026-08-10.claim: Apollo states that Athene owns and consolidates AAA and AAA Lux, which hold alternative investments.
2026-08-10.limit: These vehicles may also include third-party capital. Accounting consolidation does not mean full ownership.
2026-08-10.watch: Ownership interests and third-party investor interests.

2026-08-10.label: Indirect equity ownership
2026-08-10.claim: Athene's equity interest in Atlas is held through its investments in AAA and AAA Lux.
2026-08-10.limit: This ownership chain is separate from the Atlas securities Athene holds directly.
2026-08-10.watch: Changes in ownership interests and scope.

2026-08-10.label: Investment in securities
2026-08-10.claim: Athene reports holding available-for-sale securities issued by Atlas or its affiliates as of June 30, 2026.
2026-08-10.limit: This link groups the Atlas and affiliate issuers cited in the report. It measures neither a loss nor a new flow of funds.

2026-08-10.label: Management of funds and vehicles
2026-08-10.claim: Apollo raises and manages funds, accounts and vehicles for institutional and individual investors.
2026-08-10.limit: This node groups distinct vehicles. It represents neither a single fund nor a blanket Apollo guarantee.

2026-09-08.label: Offering announced · $750m
2026-09-08.claim: ARCC announces a $750 million principal offering with a 6.250% annual coupon, maturing on September 15, 2033. Closing is expected on September 15, 2026.
2026-09-08.limit: At this date, closing remains conditional. Principal differs from net proceeds after the discount and fees.

2026-09-15.label: Offering closed · $750m
2026-09-15.claim: ARCC confirms the September 15 closing of its $750 million principal offering. These unsecured notes carry a 6.250% coupon and mature on September 15, 2033. Net proceeds are intended to repay debt under its credit facilities.
2026-09-15.limit: Repayment remains a stated intended use. The coupon does not capture the cost after the interest rate swap with JPMorgan. No financing of a particular portfolio loan can be inferred.
2026-09-15.watch: Completed repayments and the effects of the interest rate swap.

2026-09-29.label: Announced closing · VFN warehouse
2026-09-29.claim: Pagaya announces the closing of a revolving VFN facility with ATLAS SP, targeting approximately $700 million of capacity. The structure provides for a dedicated vehicle to warehouse personal loans before securitization.
2026-09-29.limit: The release does not give the vehicle's legal name, publish the agreement or disclose drawdowns. Capacity is not confirmed cash received. No financing from BNP or Athene to this warehouse is established.
2026-09-29.watch: Vehicle identity, agreement, drawdowns and maturities.

2024-09-20.label: BNP and ATLAS SP
2024-09-20.change: An announced financing partnership and ownership by Apollo funds. This view reproduces the position described in the 2024 release.

2026-07-29.label: The Ares financing chain
2026-07-29.change: ARCC's report as of June 30, 2026 distinguishes its manager, bank facilities, financing subsidiary and a loan to Hyland Software.

2026-08-10.label: The insurance financing chain
2026-08-10.change: Apollo and Athene's reports as of June 30, 2026 describe management mandates, indirect ownership and securities holdings. Links from 2024 retain their original date.

2026-09-08.label: The bond offering
2026-09-08.change: ARCC announces a bond offering to refinance debt under its credit facilities. This release does not yet confirm completion.

2026-09-15.label: The offering closes
2026-09-15.change: The 8-K confirms the offering closed. ARCC's bond financing appears alongside its bank facilities; actual repayments remain to be documented.

2026-09-29.label: The Pagaya loan warehouse
2026-09-29.change: Pagaya announces a revolving facility with ATLAS SP to hold personal loans ahead of securitization. Target capacity and drawdowns are distinct.
